assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The regulatory plan for blocks along the Heritage Park was approved on 2026-08-12 (source PARK-CONTROL-PLAN). Its content has not been published to this repository; wherever this conceptual proposal conflicts with its control conditions, the official plan prevails.
assumptions.impact: All conceptual zoning, intensity suggestions and crossing designs are subordinate to the approved regulatory plan once its conditions are available.

assumptions.statement: Public search shows 'smart rail' exists as a technical term in rail transit. The naming combination Jing-Zhang Smart Rail is used conceptually only; professional trademark clearance is required before any formal use.
assumptions.impact: No commercial registration is claimed; naming risk is disclosed and bounded.

assumptions.statement: The 7 concept images in assets/media/ are AI-generated design-intent illustrations (Gemini image model via ListenHub API), not site evidence; prompts and toolchain are recorded in report/narrative.md.
assumptions.impact: Images carry alt text and are strictly separated from factual claims sourced from public reports.
